text:
emily: CI red on main — multiple ubuntu-latest jobs failing with 'Wheel not supported on this platform' for cryptography wheel after lockfile update. Job: test-py310-linux. Commit: 9f4b2c1
ci-bot: test-py310-linux failed on step 'pip install -r requirements.txt' (exit code 1)
sarah: :eyes: I'll bisect the PRs merged in the last 24h, but likely the poetry.lock bump that updated cryptography from 38.0.1 -> 41.0.0
mike: can someone paste the pip error? I want to see tag mismatch
emily: paste log: ```ERROR: cryptography-41.0.0-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl is not a supported wheel on this platform.```
josh: that's usually because the wheel was built with a newer manylinux tag not present on runner; Ubuntu 20/22 maybe lack glibc. Did the runner image change?
sarah: runner is ubuntu-22.04, unchanged. The lock bump came from dependabot PR #4221.
mike: try pip download cryptography==41.0.0 --no-binary :all: locally on ubuntu:22.04 docker to reproduce
emily: I ran docker reproduce: `docker run --rm -it ubuntu:22.04 bash -c 'apt update && apt install -y python3.10 python3.10-venv python3.10-dev build-essential && python3.10 -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install pip --upgrade && pip install cryptography==41.0.0'` -> compiled fine for me
josh: hmmm compiling ok locally but wheel from pip is manylinux tag; CI still errors trying to install wheel rather than build? Maybe pip is trying to install a cached wheel with bad tag.
sarah: CI uses pip 22.3.1 according to the log.
mike: older pip might not accept new platform tags or handle manylinux_2_17 vs manylinux2014 mapping. Can we check pip --version on runners?
emily: `pip 22.3.1` per job log
mike: ok. Quick mitigation: rerun failing job with PIP_NO_BINARY=cryptography env so it builds from source. Can someone request rerun?
sarah: I'm going to rerun failing job with `PIP_NO_BINARY=cryptography` env to force build from source.
ci-bot: rerun requested by sarah on job test-py310-linux #3425
emily: thanks. If that passes we can pin cryptography to 38.0.1 in lock and open a patch for dependabot to restrict wheel tags.
josh: also add a check in our CI that pip --version >= 23.0 to avoid old pip issues.
mike: quick bisect: sarah any chance you can run 'poetry lock --no-update' on the PR head to confirm lock change?
sarah: started a local bisect: confirm lock change came from dependabot; reproducing build with `pip install --no-binary :all: cryptography==41.0.0` succeeded, but install from wheel failed in CI. Rerun started.
ci-bot: job passed on rerun with PIP_NO_BINARY set.
emily: OK so build-from-source is fine. For now I'll push a hotfix: add environment override in CI to force source build for cryptography until we pin the wheel/upgrade pip.
mike: please open a follow-up issue to track upgrading runner images and pinning/workarounds.
sarah: created issue #876: 'cryptography wheel tag incompatibility — investigate runner/pip'. Assigning to infra.
emily: PR with CI change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/abc123
josh: nice. Later we should inform dependabot to prefer older wheel-compatible releases or add a constraint. Let's sync tomorrow if needed. :thumbsup:
